title: 油价与收益率上行，存储、网安、智驾领涨后夜盘降温；安克、三一业绩超预期 + 美股盘前：债券抛售与油价压低期指，能源、MDT与HOOD逆势获承接
summary: 油价与利率压力并存；存储、网络安全、智驾现金盘领涨后夜盘降温，安克与三一业绩超预期。 QQQ盘前跌1.18%，SPY与DIA均跌约0.63%，10年期美债收益率升至4.79%；USO涨2.29%、XLE涨1.22%，XOM、CVX、MDT与HOOD获得正价格反馈。NIO收入低于预期且盘前下跌，只作观察；今晚关注DELL、CRDO、MDB、PANW与GTLB财报。

重大新闻汇总
国际
美军打击伊朗发射设施，霍尔木兹风险溢价重新抬升
AP 8月31日报道，美国打击霍尔木兹海峡附近的伊朗火箭发射设施，为近一个月来首次新的军事行动；阿联酋还拦截一架伊朗无人机。Brent收盘涨约2.7%并站上90美元，WTI当前再涨0.97%。事实是冲突与航运风险升温，判断是A/H油气、油运相对受益，而航空、化工下游与高估值资产承受通胀和利率压力。
国际
美国进口无人机100%关税将生效，中美低空供应链面临再分层
白宫公布的8月措施显示，所列进口无人机、停靠站和关键部件自9月3日起加征100%关税；中国此前已宣布相关无人机出口管制。政策生效时间可验证，但企业订单转移尚未验证。A/H映射偏向国产替代和非美市场，同时需警惕大疆生态链、零部件出口与海外渠道的成本冲击。
科技
隔夜科技异常集中在储备型加密、智驾与存储，行业全榜因WAF留空
Moomoo行业页仅取得前30项：汽车制造+4.03%（GGR +14.35%）、油服+2.91%（SLB +4.83%）、半导体+1.03%（MOBX +18.92%）；分页接口WAF/403，未完成145行业全榜，故面板行业组输出0行。Sparks首屏正榜为以太坊储备+5.48%、加密储备+4.21%、新能源汽车+4.21%、充电桩+4.05%、加密货币股+2.92%；可靠负榜缺失，负向仅列ICLN、GDX、COPX、KWEB、TAN五个ETF压力样本，不表述为完整倒数榜。
科技
SNDK与存储概念领涨后夜盘回吐，A/H存储链进入量价验证
SNDK常规时段涨5.50%，Moomoo存储概念涨2.26%，市场将指数纳入资金与AI存储需求列为催化；08:36 CST的Futu夜盘快照显示SNDK -1.24%，构成潜在反转而非确认。A/H映射江波龙、佰维存储、兆易创新，只有高开后守住前收且成交扩张才确认，风险是美股领涨股继续回吐及存储价格预期透支。
科技
CrowdStrike上涨5.78%，安全平台合作推动网络安全板块扩散
CRWD常规时段涨5.78%，Moomoo网络安全概念涨2.12%；Fal.Con 2026合作发布、Google Cloud部署与此前业绩动能构成可核验催化。夜盘CRWD -0.21%，仅是轻微降温。A/H映射奇安信、深信服和云安全链，触发条件是板块相对科技指数走强，风险是高估值、合作落地节奏和美股夜盘延续回吐。
科技
Tesla与Qualcomm共振智驾和AI PC，夜盘却出现温和背离
TSLA常规时段涨5.51%，对应新能源汽车与充电桩概念均涨4%以上，市场交易9月3日Cybercab活动与FSD/Robotaxi预期；QCOM涨3.83%，CPU概念涨1.39%，AI PC及数据中心产品扩张提供催化。夜盘TSLA -0.22%、QCOM -0.20%，均属潜在反转信号。A/H关注比亚迪、地平线、联想和中芯国际，事件兑现与估值回吐是主要风险。
财报
地平线机器人中期收入与EPS低于一致预期，正式价格反馈待开盘
Futu本地财报日历显示，地平线机器人-W（09660）2026Q2收入20.55亿元，较一致预期21.07亿元低2.48%；EPS 0.2388元，较预期0.28元低14.7%。公司投资者关系页列示19:30 HKT业绩会。数据发布后尚无下一交易时段，4.72港元是报告日前收附近价格，不能当作财报后反馈；城市NOA订单、毛利率与费用指引是后续验证点。
财报
三一重工收入与EPS双双超预期，下一交易日反应仍未形成
Futu本地日历显示，三一重工（600031/06031）2026Q2收入292.63亿元，较一致预期266.41亿元高9.84%；EPS 0.35元，较预期0.2752元高27.2%。港股报告日收19.61港元、较前收+5.49%，但日历时间为15:00 CST，不能把全天涨幅完全归因于财报；真正的发布后价格反馈要看今天开盘、海外需求和现金流。
财报
安克创新收入稳健、EPS大幅超预期，港股反馈需等待首个完整交易时段
Futu本地日历显示，安克创新（300866/00668）2026Q2收入89.97亿元，较一致预期86.53亿元高3.98%；EPS 2.26元，较预期1.4278元高58.3%。港股价格移动接口暂未取得有效发布后样本，因此不能声称市场已确认。新品、海外渠道和毛利率是正向触发，关税、汇率与高开兑现是主要风险。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
夜盘指数
Futu OpenD 08:36 CST快照：QQQ 716.40、较常规收盘-0.05%（交易所时间20:35:50 ET）；SPY 767.71、+0.09%（20:35:51 ET）；DIA 532.56、+0.19%（最新成交20:19:49 ET）。快照未标延迟，但DIA时间较早；指数代理整体分化，不能据此判断全面风险偏好。
对照
板块对照
现金盘正榜代表COSM夜盘+3.21%、ASST +0.74%，属于确认；TSLA -0.22%同时对应新能源汽车与充电桩，去重后为背离/潜在反转；CCPUF无可用报价。压力样本ICLN -0.06%为确认，GDX +0.18%、COPX +0.53%、KWEB +0.27%为潜在反转，TAN无夜盘成交。SNDK -1.24%、CRWD -0.21%、QCOM -0.20%、NVDA -0.25%也显示科技领涨股普遍降温。行业全榜失败，故无行业代表股可对照。
映射
A/H 映射
结论不是追涨所有科技：存储、网安、智驾和AI PC的现金盘催化仍在，但夜盘多只代表股回吐，A/H更适合等待开盘确认；油价+0.97%、美债10年收益率升至4.76%则支持油气相对强、压制高久期估值。若佰维/江波龙、比亚迪/地平线、奇安信/深信服高开守不住前收，应视为美股潜在反转向A/H传导；若放量守住，才升级为确认。

盘前结论

事实：美股现金盘能源、存储、网络安全与智驾偏强，安克和三一收入/EPS高于一致预期。10年期美债收益率升至4.76%，霍尔木兹风险推高油价和通胀约束。

判断：A/H基准情景是油气相对占优，业绩超预期个股与科技映射等待量价确认。QQQ夜盘微跌且SNDK、CRWD、TSLA、QCOM均回吐，避免把现金盘涨幅直接外推。

不确定性：行业全榜与可靠概念负榜未完整取得；地缘冲突、无人机关税、业绩会指引和开盘成交都可能改变路径。前30分钟以守住前收、相对指数强弱和成交扩张为最终验证。

重点个股推荐

安克创新
300866 / 00668
业绩超预期

推荐理由：收入高于一致预期3.98%、EPS高58.3%，消费电子出海的盈利质量优于单纯主题映射。

触发因素：A/H开盘守住前收、成交放大，且管理层确认新品与毛利率趋势。

风险点：美国无人机/电子供应链关税、汇率、渠道库存和高开兑现。

三一重工
600031 / 06031
业绩超预期

推荐理由：收入高于一致预期9.84%、EPS高27.2%，为机械出海与国内设备需求提供本地盈利支点。

触发因素：H股与A股开盘均守住前收，并强于工程机械板块。

风险点：报告日涨幅未必来自财报；海外周期、应收和现金流可能弱于利润。

佰维存储
688525
存储映射

推荐理由：SNDK +5.50%、存储概念+2.26%提供美股映射，AI端侧存储需求仍是中期催化。

触发因素：高开不超过可承接范围，守住前收并在首小时放量强于科创板。

风险点：SNDK夜盘-1.24%提示潜在反转，存储价格预期和估值可能已透支。

比亚迪股份
01211
智驾映射

推荐理由：TSLA +5.51%，新能源汽车与充电桩概念均涨4%以上，Cybercab/FSD事件提升智驾关注度。

触发因素：守住前收并强于恒生科技/汽车板块，智能驾驶消息得到成交确认。

风险点：TSLA夜盘回吐、事件兑现不及预期、价格竞争和海外关税。

板块轮动看板

相对强势油气、油服与油运：WTI当前+0.97%，霍尔木兹事件维持供给溢价；优先看油价能否守住涨幅。
科技催化存储、网络安全、智驾与AI PC现金盘领涨，但代表股夜盘普遍回吐，必须等待A/H开盘确认。
业绩驱动安克、三一收入与EPS超预期；地平线低于一致预期。发布后首个完整交易时段决定方向。
压力区高久期成长、航空及能源下游面临4.76%美债收益率和油价上行；无人机出口链另有100%关税风险。

逻辑链条

霍尔木兹军事行动与航运担忧 → Brent站上90美元、WTI继续上涨 → A/H油气油运获得相对盈利弹性，同时推高通胀。
10年期美债收益率4.76% → 高久期科技估值折现率上升 → 存储、网安、智驾只能依靠具体催化与成交确认。
美股现金盘科技主题领涨 → SNDK/CRWD/TSLA/QCOM夜盘回吐 → A/H开盘追涨胜率下降，优先选择业绩或产业催化更实的标的。
安克、三一超预期与地平线低预期形成分化 → 首个发布后交易时段价格反馈 → 决定业绩交易能否脱离宏观压制。

风险雷达

霍尔木兹升级

进一步打击、报复或航运中断会迅速推升油价与通胀预期，并扩大成长股压力。

美债收益率上行

10年期收益率已至4.76%；若继续上行，存储、智驾与高估值科技的现金盘催化可能失效。

科技夜盘反转

SNDK、CRWD、TSLA、QCOM和NVDA均回吐；A/H高开失守前收即把推荐降级为观察。

数据覆盖缺口

行业145项全榜和可靠概念负榜未取得；0行行业组和ETF压力样本不能用于推断完整市场广度。

财报时点与反馈

三家公司均没有完整的下一交易日反馈；一致预期比较不等于管理层指引，需听业绩会并看成交。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时间：AP（8月31日美伊行动、油价、美股收盘与美债收益率）；美国白宫8月无人机进口关税公告；Moomoo美股行业页与Sparks首屏（约08:30 CST，行业分页WAF/403）；Futu OpenD本地财报日历、历史价格与08:36 CST夜盘快照；Horizon Robotics投资者关系页；Yahoo Finance公开行情交叉核验（约08:36 CST）。页面更新2026-09-01 08:50 CST。行业榜不完整故输出0行；概念负向为ICLN、GDX、COPX、KWEB、TAN ETF压力样本；夜盘快照无延迟标志但个别成交时间较早或无成交。

Keyword Cloud

Hormuz Risk Storage Leads Cybersecurity Autonomy Heat AI PC Anker Beat Sany Beat Horizon Miss Drone Tariff Industry Gap Pressure Proxies Overnight Split
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Global
US strikes Iranian launch sites as the Hormuz premium rebuilds
AP reported Aug. 31 that the US struck Iranian rocket launch facilities near the Strait of Hormuz, its first new military action in about a month; the UAE also intercepted an Iranian drone. Brent closed about 2.7% higher above $90 and WTI is currently up another 0.97%. Escalation is fact; relative support for A/H oil producers and shippers, versus inflation and rate pressure on airlines, chemical users and long-duration assets, is the market inference.
Global
A 100% US drone import tariff is set to start, splitting the low-altitude supply chain
The White House's August measure applies a 100% tariff to listed imported drones, docking stations and critical components from Sep. 3; China had already announced related drone export controls. The effective date is verified, while order relocation is not. A/H implications favor domestic substitution and non-US channels, with export-cost risk for the DJI ecosystem, component makers and overseas distributors.
Tech
Tech anomalies center on crypto treasuries, autonomy and storage; the industry table stays empty
Only Moomoo's first 30 industry items were obtained: auto manufacturing +4.03% (GGR +14.35%), oil services +2.91% (SLB +4.83%) and semiconductors +1.03% (MOBX +18.92%). Pagination hit WAF/403, leaving the 145-industry scan incomplete, so the panel publishes zero industry rows. Sparks' positive first-page Top5 were ETH treasuries +5.48%, crypto treasuries +4.21%, EV +4.21%, charging stations +4.05% and crypto stocks +2.92%. Reliable negatives were unavailable; ICLN, GDX, COPX, KWEB and TAN are disclosed ETF pressure samples, not a complete bottom ranking.
Tech
SNDK and storage lead, then give back gains overnight
SNDK gained 5.50% in regular trading and Moomoo storage concepts rose 2.26%, with index-inclusion flows and AI-storage demand cited as catalysts. Futu's 08:36 CST overnight snapshot showed SNDK -1.24%, a potential reversal rather than confirmation. A/H mappings include Longsys, Biwin Storage and GigaDevice; a gap that holds above the prior close with expanding volume is the trigger, while continued US giveback and over-discounted memory pricing are the risks.
Tech
CrowdStrike gains 5.78% as security-platform partnerships broaden the move
CRWD gained 5.78% in regular trading and Moomoo cybersecurity concepts rose 2.12%. Fal.Con 2026 partnerships, Google Cloud deployment and prior earnings momentum are verifiable catalysts. CRWD eased 0.21% overnight, only mild cooling. A/H mappings include Qi-Anxin, Sangfor and cloud-security vendors; relative strength versus tech is the trigger, while valuation, execution timing and further overnight giveback are risks.
Tech
Tesla and Qualcomm lift autonomy and AI PCs, but both ease overnight
TSLA gained 5.51% as EV and charging concepts both rose more than 4%, with traders positioning for the Sep. 3 Cybercab event and FSD/Robotaxi expectations. QCOM rose 3.83%, while CPU concepts gained 1.39% on AI-PC and data-center expansion. Overnight TSLA -0.22% and QCOM -0.20% are mild potential reversals. A/H mappings include BYD, Horizon Robotics, Lenovo and SMIC; event disappointment and valuation giveback are the main risks.
Earnings
Horizon Robotics revenue and EPS miss consensus; post-release price feedback is pending
Futu's local calendar shows Horizon Robotics (09660) 2026Q2 revenue of RMB2.055 billion, 2.48% below RMB2.107 billion consensus, and EPS of RMB0.2388, 14.7% below RMB0.28 consensus. The IR page lists a 19:30 HKT results call. No next trading session exists after the release; HK$4.72 is around the report-date close and cannot be treated as post-earnings feedback. Urban-NOA orders, gross margin and expense guidance are the next checks.
Earnings
Sany revenue and EPS beat, while the next-session response is still pending
Futu's local calendar shows Sany (600031/06031) 2026Q2 revenue of RMB29.263 billion, 9.84% above RMB26.641 billion consensus, and EPS of RMB0.35, 27.2% above RMB0.2752 consensus. The HK line closed at HK$19.61, +5.49% on the report date, but the calendar timestamp is 15:00 CST, so the full-day move cannot be attributed entirely to results. Today's open, overseas demand and cash flow provide the real post-release test.
Earnings
Anker posts a revenue beat and a large EPS beat; HK feedback awaits a full session
Futu's local calendar shows Anker Innovations (300866/00668) 2026Q2 revenue of RMB8.997 billion, 3.98% above RMB8.653 billion consensus, and EPS of RMB2.26, 58.3% above RMB1.4278 consensus. The HK price-move endpoint has no valid post-release sample, so market confirmation cannot be claimed. Products, overseas channels and margin are positive triggers; tariffs, FX and gap-selling are key risks.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight
Overnight Indexes
Futu OpenD's 08:36 CST snapshot showed QQQ at 716.40, -0.05% from the regular close (exchange time 20:35:50 ET); SPY at 767.71, +0.09% (20:35:51 ET); and DIA at 532.56, +0.19% (last trade 20:19:49 ET). The snapshot has no delay flag, but DIA's trade is older. Index proxies are mixed, not a broad risk-on or risk-off signal.
Cross-check
Sector Cross-check
Positive-panel representatives COSM +3.21% and ASST +0.74% overnight are confirmations. TSLA -0.22%, shared by EV and charging and de-duplicated, is a divergence/potential reversal; CCPUF has no usable quote. Among pressure samples, ICLN -0.06% confirms, while GDX +0.18%, COPX +0.53% and KWEB +0.27% are potential reversals; TAN had no overnight trade. SNDK -1.24%, CRWD -0.21%, QCOM -0.20% and NVDA -0.25% also show broad cooling among tech leaders. The industry scan failed, so there are no industry representatives to compare.
Mapping
A/H Mapping
The signal is not to chase every tech name: cash-session catalysts remain in storage, cybersecurity, autonomy and AI PCs, but most overnight representatives gave back gains, so A/H needs opening confirmation. WTI +0.97% and the US 10-year yield at 4.76% support relative oil strength and pressure long-duration valuations. If Biwin/Longsys, BYD/Horizon or Qi-AnXin/Sangfor cannot hold their prior closes after a gap, treat the US potential reversal as transmitted; a high-volume hold is required for confirmation.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: energy, storage, cybersecurity and autonomy led US cash trading, while Anker and Sany beat revenue/EPS consensus.The US 10-year yield rose to 4.76%, and Hormuz risk lifts oil and the inflation constraint.

View: the A/H base case favors relative oil strength, with earnings beats and tech mappings subject to price-volume confirmation.QQQ edged down overnight and SNDK, CRWD, TSLA and QCOM all gave back gains, so cash-session strength should not be extrapolated.

Uncertainty: the complete industry table and reliable concept negatives were unavailable; conflict, drone tariffs, earnings-call guidance and opening turnover can change the path. Holding the prior close, relative strength and volume expansion in the first 30 minutes are the final tests.

Key Stock Setups

Anker Innovations
300866 / 00668
Earnings beat

Rationale: Revenue beat consensus by 3.98% and EPS by 58.3%, providing stronger earnings quality than a pure consumer-electronics theme mapping.

Trigger: Both lines hold the prior close with expanding volume, while management confirms product and margin trends.

Risk: US drone/electronics tariffs, FX, channel inventory and gap-selling.

Sany Heavy Industry
600031 / 06031
Earnings beat

Rationale: Revenue beat consensus by 9.84% and EPS by 27.2%, supporting machinery exports and domestic equipment demand with local earnings.

Trigger: Both HK and A-share lines hold the prior close and outperform machinery peers.

Risk: The report-date gain may not be earnings-driven; overseas cycles, receivables and cash flow may lag profit.

Biwin Storage
688525
Storage mapping

Rationale: SNDK +5.50% and storage concepts +2.26% provide a US mapping, while edge-AI storage demand remains a medium-term catalyst.

Trigger: A manageable gap holds above the prior close and outperforms STAR Market on expanding first-hour volume.

Risk: SNDK's -1.24% overnight move signals potential reversal; memory-price expectations and valuation may be over-discounted.

BYD Company
01211
Autonomy mapping

Rationale: TSLA +5.51% and gains above 4% in both EV and charging concepts lift attention on autonomy ahead of the Cybercab/FSD event.

Trigger: Hold the prior close, outperform Hang Seng Tech/auto peers and confirm autonomy news with turnover.

Risk: TSLA's overnight giveback, event disappointment, price competition and overseas tariffs.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative strengthOil producers, services and shipping: WTI is currently +0.97% and Hormuz maintains a supply premium; first test whether oil holds gains.
Tech catalystsStorage, cybersecurity, autonomy and AI PCs led cash trading, but most representatives eased overnight; A/H opening confirmation is required.
Earnings-drivenAnker and Sany beat revenue and EPS; Horizon missed consensus. The first full post-release session decides direction.
PressureLong-duration growth, airlines and energy users face a 4.76% Treasury yield and higher oil; drone exporters also face a 100% tariff risk.

Logic Chain

Military action and shipping risk around Hormuz → Brent above $90 and WTI extending gains → relative earnings leverage for A/H oil and shipping, plus higher inflation.
The US 10-year yield at 4.76% → a higher discount rate for long-duration tech → storage, security and autonomy require specific catalysts and turnover confirmation.
US tech themes led in cash trading → SNDK/CRWD/TSLA/QCOM eased overnight → lower odds for indiscriminate A/H gap chasing, favoring stronger earnings or industry catalysts.
Anker/Sany beats versus Horizon's miss → first post-release session feedback → determines whether earnings trades can overcome macro pressure.

Risk Radar

Hormuz escalation

Further strikes, retaliation or shipping disruption can quickly lift oil and inflation expectations and broaden pressure on growth.

Yield repricing

The 10-year yield is already 4.76%; another rise can overwhelm cash-session catalysts in storage, autonomy and expensive tech.

Tech overnight reversal

SNDK, CRWD, TSLA, QCOM and NVDA all gave back gains; an A/H gap that loses the prior close downgrades the setup to watch.

Coverage gaps

The full 145-industry table and reliable concept negatives were unavailable; zero industry rows and ETF samples cannot infer complete breadth.

Earnings timing and feedback

None of the three companies has a full next-session response; consensus comparisons are not management guidance, so calls and turnover matter.

Sources and Timestamps

Sources and times: AP (Aug. 31 US-Iran action, oil, US close and Treasury yields); the White House's August drone-import tariff notice; Moomoo US industry page and Sparks first page (about 08:30 CST; industry pagination hit WAF/403); Futu OpenD local earnings calendar, historical prices and 08:36 CST overnight snapshot; Horizon Robotics IR; Yahoo Finance public-quote cross-checks (about 08:36 CST). Page updated Sep. 1, 2026, 08:50 CST. The incomplete industry ranking publishes zero rows; negative concepts are ICLN, GDX, COPX, KWEB and TAN ETF pressure samples; Futu snapshots had no delay flag but some prints were older or absent.

entries.title: 美股盘前：债券抛售与油价压低期指，能源、MDT与HOOD逆势获承接
entries.summary: QQQ盘前跌1.18%，SPY与DIA均跌约0.63%，10年期美债收益率升至4.79%；USO涨2.29%、XLE涨1.22%，XOM、CVX、MDT与HOOD获得正价格反馈。NIO收入低于预期且盘前下跌，只作观察；今晚关注DELL、CRDO、MDB、PANW与GTLB财报。
entries.html:
关键资产图

SPY盘前代理
-0.63% 低开压力
QQQ盘前代理
-1.18% 科技承压
能源ETF XLE
+1.22% 逆势领涨
原油ETF USO
+2.29% 通胀冲击
长债ETF TLT
-0.49% 利率压制
黄金ETF GLD
-2.02% 避险失灵

关键词云图

债券抛售科技降温能源领涨霍尔木兹MDT上调HOOD升级苹果换帅利率高位JOLTS与ISM科技财报夜NIO负反馈九月季节性
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
宏观
全球债券抛售升温，美债10年期收益率触及4.79%
AP与Reuters 9月1日报道，美国2年期收益率升至4.35%，10年期升至4.79%、为2025年1月以来最高；日本与德国10年期收益率也触及多年高位。事实是全球期限溢价与通胀担忧同步抬升；判断是高久期科技估值受压，抛售是否扩展仍取决于10:00 ET数据。
能源
霍尔木兹风险继续推高油价，能源股逆势获承接
AP称伊朗战争已压缩霍尔木兹海峡通行，Brent约92美元、涨1.7%，WTI约87.67美元、涨2.2%；20:34 CST的Futu快照显示USO +2.29%、XLE +1.22%，XOM +1.52%、CVX +1.34%。事实利好能源盈利弹性，但对大盘构成通胀与利率双重压力。
期指
纳指期货跌约1%，科技弱于大盘而非全面恐慌
AP记录标普500、道指和纳指期货分别约跌0.6%、0.8%和1%；Futu 20:34 CST显示SPY -0.63%、QQQ -1.18%、DIA -0.63%。NVDA、MSFT、GOOG、MU盘前分别约-1.65%、-1.29%、-0.91%、-2.41%，价格反馈确认科技是主要压力源。
政策
FedWatch显示9月维持区间概率66.4%，加息尾部风险仍高
Futu FedWatch在20:34 CST给出9月16日目标区间3.75%—4.00%的概率66.4%，3.50%—3.75%概率33.6%；AP称Warsh把抗通胀置于核心。概率不是政策承诺，今日JOLTS、ISM物价支付和周五就业数据都可能重新定价。
数据
JOLTS与ISM将在开盘后半小时公布，低开后波动或二次放大
Futu经济日历显示10:00 ET公布7月JOLTS职位空缺，一致预期730万、前值735.9万；8月ISM制造业PMI预期55.2、前值55.6，物价支付预期70.5。就业走弱与物价偏强若同时出现，将形成对股市最不利的滞胀组合。
财报
Medtronic收入与EPS领先指引并上调全年展望，盘前涨2.37%
MDT公布FY2027 Q1收入97.56亿美元、同比增13.7%，非GAAP EPS 1.45美元；全年有机收入增长指引由6.75%—7.25%上调至7.25%—7.75%，非GAAP EPS区间收窄上移至5.94—6.00美元。盘前成交约19.7万股，正反馈与量能均可验证。
财报
NIO盈利质量改善但收入低于预期，盘前负反馈要求回避追多
NIO Q2收入321.37亿元、同比增69.1%，低于Futu一致预期332.77亿元；GAAP每ADS亏损0.29元好于预期亏损0.3107元，三季度收入指引332.85亿—340.51亿元。尽管非GAAP经营利润转正，盘前约跌1.42%、成交约479万股，说明市场仍在惩罚收入缺口与环比利润走弱。
科技
Apple进入Ternus时代，AAPL在科技抛售中保持相对抗跌
Apple官方安排John Ternus自9月1日起接任CEO，Tim Cook转任执行董事长；AAPL盘前约+0.09%、成交约51.7万股，明显强于QQQ。相对强势是事实，但换帅本身不是盈利上调，AI追赶、供应链与新机发布执行仍是验证重点。
评级
Robinhood获摩根士丹利上调评级，盘前涨1.45%
Reuters称摩根士丹利上调HOOD评级，早盘涨幅一度达2.5%；Futu 20:38 CST显示涨幅收窄至1.45%，盘前成交约47.8万股，仍显著强于SPY。评级催化获得价格确认，但若开盘失守105美元附近或加密资产转弱，应降级为观察。
财报
今晚科技财报密集，DELL与PANW市值最大
Futu财报日历与公司IR均确认DELL、PANW、CRDO、MDB、GTLB将在9月1日盘后披露。当前五股盘前均下跌0.84%—2.09%，反映宏观风险而非已知业绩结果；财报前不能把盘前跌幅误写为财报负反馈，重点看AI服务器、网络安全平台化、云数据库与开发者工具指引。

盘前结论

事实：QQQ盘前跌1.18%、SPY与DIA均跌约0.63%，10年期收益率升至4.79%；USO与XLE逆势上涨。XOM、CVX、MDT和HOOD均有可验证的正价格反馈。

判断：基准情景是指数低开、能源与少数事件股相对占优，科技反弹需要利率先止升。若JOLTS与ISM未形成滞胀组合，开盘后的超跌回补仍可能出现。

不确定性：霍尔木兹局势、Fed加息定价与10:00 ET数据可在半小时内改变节奏。以QQQ能否收复710美元、XLE能否守住64.5美元、10年期收益率是否回落至4.75%下方作为验证。

重点个股推荐

Exxon Mobil
XOM
能源领涨

推荐理由：油价续涨且XOM盘前约+1.52%、成交约36.8万股，明显强于SPY，价格与量能共同确认。

触发因素：开盘守住162美元并维持强于XLE，WTI稳定在87美元附近或更高。

风险点：霍尔木兹局势降温会挤出油价风险溢价；油价过快上涨也会强化需求破坏与政策干预预期。

Chevron
CVX
油价映射

推荐理由：CVX盘前约+1.34%、成交约13.0万股，和XOM、XLE同步走强，未出现利好兑现后的负反馈。

触发因素：守住208美元且开盘后15分钟不出现放量冲高回落，XLE保持正收益。

风险点：地缘缓和、原油快速回落或大盘系统性去风险都可能使能源股高开低走。

Medtronic
MDT
业绩上调

推荐理由：收入与非GAAP EPS领先指引并上调全年展望，盘前约+2.37%、成交约19.7万股，逆势正反馈清晰。

触发因素：开盘守住92美元、缺口保持过半，医疗器械同行不出现同步转弱。

风险点：额外一周对Q1有约5.7亿美元收入贡献；并购整合、糖尿病业务分拆与汇率会影响可比增长。

Robinhood Markets
HOOD
评级催化

推荐理由：摩根士丹利上调评级后盘前约+1.45%、成交约47.8万股，明显强于SPY与高贝塔科技。

触发因素：开盘守住105美元并重新挑战盘前高点，成交继续扩张且加密资产不转弱。

风险点：涨幅已从早段约2.5%收窄，若评级交易快速兑现或利率冲击扩大，高贝塔属性会放大回撤。

板块轮动看板

强势观察能源与综合石油：XLE、XOM、CVX、OXY盘前均上涨，MDT代表医疗器械的业绩防御。
事件驱动HOOD评级上调、Apple CEO交接；今晚DELL、PANW、CRDO、MDB、GTLB财报只做事件等待。
压力方向半导体、云软件与高久期成长；MU、CRDO、GTLB跌幅较大，NIO财报后负反馈只作观察/回避追多。
验证信号10年期收益率能否跌回4.75%、QQQ能否收复710美元、XLE能否守住64.5美元，以及JOLTS/ISM组合。

逻辑链

霍尔木兹通行受限推动Brent与WTI继续上涨，能源盈利弹性增强，但通胀尾部风险同步上升。
通胀与财政担忧引发全球债券抛售，美国10年期升至4.79%，TLT和GLD同时走弱。
更高贴现率首先压制QQQ与半导体，而XOM、CVX、MDT、HOOD凭价格正反馈形成窄幅轮动。
若10:00 ET数据缓和滞胀担忧，指数可在低开后回补；若收益率与油价继续共振上行，科技跌幅可能扩大。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下概率是基于一致预期、上一季 surprise、近期指引、分析师覆盖与行业景气作出的判断，不是确定事实；五家公司均已由Futu财报日历与公司IR确认将在9月1日盘后披露。

高概率 68% · DELL一致预期GAAP EPS 4.4029美元、收入444.96亿美元；公司Q2收入指引440亿—450亿美元、非GAAP EPS中值4.80美元。上一季EPS 5.24对2.61、收入438.42亿对357.67亿大幅超预期，AI服务器FY27收入预期升至600亿美元；13位分析师中76.9%买入。风险是高基数、AI混合毛利与盘前-0.84%。
高概率 63% · CRDO一致预期EPS 0.89美元、收入4.717亿美元；上一季EPS 0.88对0.7833、收入4.370亿对4.333亿均超预期，AI互连景气仍强，14位分析师全部买入。风险是估值、客户集中和盘前-2.09%，历史财报日反应波动很大。
中概率 58% · MDB一致预期EPS 0.0587美元、收入7.344亿美元；上一季EPS 0.05对亏损0.342、收入6.876亿对6.638亿均超预期，并上调全年指引，Atlas增长逾29%。22位分析师95.5%买入，但盘前-1.85%、高IV与企业软件预算敏感度压低确定性。
中概率 54% · PANW一致预期GAAP EPS 0.5026美元、收入33.52亿美元；上一季收入30.02亿高于29.44亿，但GAAP EPS -0.22低于0.3959，非GAAP EPS为0.85。39位分析师92.3%买入，RPO增36%支持平台化需求；CyberArk整合、口径差异与盘前-1.82%构成风险。
低概率 42% · GTLB一致预期EPS -0.193美元、收入2.734亿美元；上一季EPS -0.03好于-0.1105、收入2.642亿高于2.545亿，但财报后股价仍跌约2.8%。17位分析师仅41.2%买入、47.1%持有、11.8%卖出；AI开发工具竞争和盘前-2.02%使beat后的指引风险更高。

风险雷达

全球债券抛售

10年期美债已升至2025年1月以来最高；若突破4.80%，高久期科技和小盘股估值压力会进一步放大。

霍尔木兹升级

通行进一步受限或军事报复会推高油价与通胀，同时提高航运、航空和消费链成本。

JOLTS与ISM滞胀组合

职位空缺低于预期且物价支付高于预期，会同时削弱增长信心并强化加息定价。

NIO财报负反馈

收入低于预期且盘前下跌，按规则只观察/回避追多，等待止跌与电话会确认利润可持续性。

科技财报高波动

DELL、PANW、CRDO、MDB、GTLB的IV较高；beat不等于股价上涨，指引与估值反应可能盖过当季数字。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP与Reuters（全球债市、期指、油价、Warsh与盘前异动）；Futu OpenD实时快照、FedWatch、经济与财报日历（20:34—20:38 CST）；Medtronic、NIO、Apple、Dell、Palo Alto Networks、Credo、MongoDB公司IR；Futu历史财报与分析师一致评级。页面更新2026-09-01 20:42 CST（08:42 ET）。盘前成交为累计值；FedWatch与beat概率均会变化，GAAP/非GAAP口径已分别标注。
entries.html_en:
Key Asset Map

SPY premarket proxy
-0.63% opening pressure
QQQ premarket proxy
-1.18% tech under pressure
Energy ETF XLE
+1.22% countertrend lead
Oil ETF USO
+2.29% inflation shock
Long Treasury ETF TLT
-0.49% rate pressure
Gold ETF GLD
-2.02% haven failure

Keyword Cloud

Bond selloffTech coolingEnergy leadsStrait of HormuzMDT raisesHOOD upgradeApple transitionHigh yieldsJOLTS and ISMTech earnings nightNIO negative feedbackSeptember seasonality
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes heat and importance, not percentage moves.
Major News Summary
Macro
Global bond selloff deepens as the US 10-year yield reaches 4.79%
AP and Reuters reported on September 1 that the US 2-year yield rose to 4.35% and the 10-year to 4.79%, its highest since January 2025; Japanese and German 10-year yields also reached multi-year highs. The fact is that term premiums and inflation anxiety are rising together. The judgment is that long-duration tech valuations face pressure, while whether selling broadens depends on the 10:00 ET data.
Energy
Hormuz risk keeps oil elevated and energy stocks attract countertrend bids
AP said the Iran war has curtailed Strait of Hormuz traffic, with Brent near $92, up 1.7%, and WTI near $87.67, up 2.2%. Futu at 20:34 CST showed USO +2.29%, XLE +1.22%, XOM +1.52% and CVX +1.34%. This fact helps energy earnings leverage but creates a dual inflation and rate headwind for the broader market.
Futures
Nasdaq futures fall about 1% as tech underperforms without broad panic
AP recorded S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq futures down about 0.6%, 0.8% and 1%; Futu at 20:34 CST showed SPY -0.63%, QQQ -1.18% and DIA -0.63%. NVDA, MSFT, GOOG and MU were about -1.65%, -1.29%, -0.91% and -2.41% premarket, confirming tech as the main pressure point.
Policy
FedWatch assigns 66.4% to the current September range while hike tail risk stays elevated
Futu FedWatch at 20:34 CST assigned 66.4% to a 3.75%-4.00% target range on September 16 and 33.6% to 3.50%-3.75%; AP said Warsh has put inflation control at the center. Probabilities are not policy commitments, and today's JOLTS, ISM prices paid and Friday's jobs report can reprice the path.
Data
JOLTS and ISM arrive 30 minutes after the open and may amplify the second move
Futu's calendar shows July JOLTS at 10:00 ET with 7.30 million consensus versus 7.359 million prior; August ISM manufacturing is expected at 55.2 versus 55.6, with prices paid at 70.5. Weaker openings alongside stronger prices would form the most equity-negative stagflation mix.
Earnings
Medtronic beats its guide, raises the year, and gains 2.37% premarket
MDT reported FY2027 Q1 revenue of $9.756 billion, up 13.7%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.45. It lifted organic growth guidance from 6.75%-7.25% to 7.25%-7.75% and nudged the non-GAAP EPS range to $5.94-$6.00. Premarket volume was about 197,000 shares, making both price and volume confirmation verifiable.
Earnings
NIO improves earnings quality but misses revenue, requiring avoidance of chasing
NIO Q2 revenue was RMB32.137 billion, up 69.1%, but below Futu consensus of RMB33.277 billion. GAAP loss per ADS of RMB0.29 beat the RMB0.3107 loss estimate, and Q3 revenue guidance is RMB33.285-34.051 billion. Despite positive non-GAAP operating profit, shares fell about 1.42% premarket on roughly 4.79 million shares, showing the market is punishing the revenue gap and sequential profit softening.
Technology
Apple enters the Ternus era while AAPL resists the tech selloff
Apple's official plan made John Ternus CEO effective September 1 and shifted Tim Cook to executive chairman. AAPL was about +0.09% premarket on roughly 517,000 shares, clearly stronger than QQQ. Relative strength is factual, but the leadership change is not an earnings upgrade; AI execution, supply chains and upcoming product launches remain the tests.
Rating
Robinhood gains 1.45% premarket after a Morgan Stanley upgrade
Reuters said Morgan Stanley upgraded HOOD, sending it as much as 2.5% higher early. Futu at 20:38 CST showed the gain narrowed to 1.45% on about 478,000 premarket shares, still far stronger than SPY. Price confirms the rating catalyst, but a loss of roughly $105 or weaker crypto should downgrade it to watch.
Earnings
Tonight's technology earnings slate is dense, led by DELL and PANW market caps
Futu's calendar and company IR pages confirm DELL, PANW, CRDO, MDB and GTLB report after the September 1 close. All five were down 0.84%-2.09% premarket, reflecting macro risk rather than known results. The premarket drops must not be mislabeled as post-earnings feedback; guidance on AI servers, cybersecurity platforms, cloud databases and developer tools is central.

Premarket Conclusion

Fact: QQQ is down 1.18% premarket, SPY and DIA are each down about 0.63%, and the 10-year yield is at 4.79%; USO and XLE are higher.XOM, CVX, MDT and HOOD all show verifiable positive price feedback.

Judgment: The base case is a lower open with energy and a few event stocks outperforming; tech needs yields to stop rising before a durable rebound.If JOLTS and ISM do not produce a stagflation mix, an oversold rebound after the open remains possible.

Uncertainty: Hormuz developments, Fed hike pricing and the 10:00 ET data can change the tape within 30 minutes. Validate with QQQ reclaiming $710, XLE holding $64.50 and the 10-year yield falling below 4.75%.

Key Stock Picks

Exxon Mobil

Risk Radar

Global bond selloff

The 10-year yield is at its highest since January 2025; a break above 4.80% would add valuation pressure to long-duration tech and small caps.

Hormuz escalation

Further traffic restrictions or retaliation would lift oil and inflation while increasing costs for shipping, airlines and consumers.

JOLTS and ISM stagflation mix

Job openings below consensus and prices paid above consensus would weaken growth confidence while reinforcing hike pricing.

NIO earnings negative feedback

Revenue missed and shares fell premarket, so this remains watch-only and not a chase until price stabilizes and the call confirms durable profitability.

High-volatility tech earnings

DELL, PANW, CRDO, MDB and GTLB carry high IV. A beat does not guarantee a higher stock price when guidance and valuation can dominate the quarter.
